output.title: Spacious 3-Bedroom Apartment with Balcony and City Views in Kirchberg
output.description:
This recently constructed apartment offers 145 m² of well-distributed living space within Kirchberg's contemporary environment. The expansive living room benefits from a double-height ceiling and engineered wood flooring, creating an airy atmosphere complemented by south-facing windows that provide abundant natural light. The open-plan layout seamlessly integrates the dining area for versatile living and entertaining.

The kitchen is outfitted with high-end Bulthaup cabinetry, featuring a central island with a breakfast bar and an induction cooktop set against a durable stone worktop. Its minimalist design prioritizes functionality and refined aesthetics.

Three bedrooms provide multiple sleeping areas, accompanied by two bathrooms finished with porcelain tiles. The ensuite bathroom includes a walk-in rain shower, double vanity, and underfloor heating that extends throughout the apartment, enhancing comfort.

A private balcony with a glass balustrade overlooks a park in Kirchberg, offering a tranquil setting for morning coffee or quiet relaxation. Additional amenities include an elevator, parking space, and a cellar for storage needs.

Situated in Kirchberg, the city’s modern business district known for its EU institutions, Philharmonie, and MUDAM, the location features contemporary residential complexes and international schools, reflecting a progressive urban context.

highlights.text: Balcony with park views and glass balustrade
Bulthaup kitchen with stone worktop and induction cooktop
Double-height ceiling in living room with south-facing windows
Underfloor heating and walk-in rain shower in ensuite
Elevator access and parking space included
